newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end mixed, Portucel firm.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end mixed, Portucel firm.

text.p: 1645 GMT - Shares closed mixed to slightly weaker with pulp producer Portucel firm but off its early highs hit after the company announced that international stocks probably fell sharply last month.
*Traders said several stocks dipped on profit-taking after the sharp gains of recent sessions. Turnover was a lively 12.8 billion escudos.

*The market was seen fluctuating over the next few sessions, with some more profit-taking likely but with other investors also standing ready to reinforce their positions as prices eased, traders said.
*"I think the overall sentiment remains positive. The mood abroad is also positive and this is giving some support," said one trader.
*The PSI-20 .PSI20 fell 0.28 percent to 6,729.16 pontos, with the May futures retreating a similar amount.
